info.title: Zeno API
info.description:
Everything the web app, the extension and the studio ask the API.

Errors always look like `{"error": {"code", "message", "fields"?}}`; branch on `code`. Browsers send `Origin`, and state-changing requests from any other origin are refused with `403 forbidden_origin`.

get.summary: The signed-in user's own recent security activity, newest first.

post.summary: Emails a password reset link, if the account exists.

400.description: `invalid_request`: the body is not valid JSON for this route.

403.description: `forbidden_origin`: the request came from a site that is not the web app.

422.description: `validation_failed` (see `fields`) or `invalid_request` (the JSON has the wrong shape or an unknown field).

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the budget is available again.

post.summary: Signs in with an email and password.

400.description: `invalid_request`: the body is not valid JSON for this route.

401.description: `invalid_credentials`: the same answer for an unknown email and a wrong password.

403.description: `email_not_verified` (the password was right but the address is not confirmed) or `forbidden_origin`.

422.description: `invalid_request`: valid JSON, but not the shape this route takes (or an unknown field).

429.description: `too_many_requests`: too many failures for this email or address.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the budget is available again.

post.summary: Ends this session and clears the cookies. Safe to repeat.

403.description: `forbidden_origin`: the request came from a site that is not the web app.

401.description: `unauthenticated`: no session, or it expired. Refresh and retry once.

post.summary: Rotates the session. Reads the refresh cookie; sends no body and returns none.
post.description:
A refresh token is single-use. If two tabs refresh at once, one gets `401 refresh_conflict`
and should simply retry.

204.description: A new pair of cookies was set.

401.description: `unauthenticated` (no cookie), `refresh_conflict` (retry shortly) or `session_expired` (the cookies are cleared; sign in again).

403.description: `forbidden_origin`: the request came from a site that is not the web app.

post.summary: Creates an account and emails a link to verify it.
post.description:
The answer is the same whether or not the email was already registered, so this cannot be used
to find out who has an account.

202.description: Accepted. A link is on its way if the address can be used.

400.description: `invalid_request`: the body is not valid JSON for this route.

403.description: `forbidden_origin`: the request came from a site that is not the web app.

422.description: `validation_failed` (every invalid field at once, in `fields`) or `invalid_request` (the JSON has the wrong shape or an unknown field).

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the budget is available again.

503.description: `unavailable`: the limiter is down, and this route fails closed.

post.summary: Sends a new verification link, if the account exists and still needs one.

400.description: `invalid_request`: the body is not valid JSON for this route.

403.description: `forbidden_origin`: the request came from a site that is not the web app.

422.description: `validation_failed` (see `fields`) or `invalid_request` (the JSON has the wrong shape or an unknown field).

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the budget is available again.

post.summary: Sets a new password with the one-time token from the reset link, and ends every other session.

200.description: Password updated. The person signs in again.

400.description: `invalid_token` (the link is wrong, used or expired) or `invalid_request` (a malformed body).

403.description: `forbidden_origin`: the request came from a site that is not the web app.

422.description: `validation_failed` (the new password is not allowed) or `invalid_request` (the JSON has the wrong shape).

post.summary: Confirms an email address with the one-time token from the link, and signs the person in.

400.description: `invalid_token` (the link is wrong, used or expired) or `invalid_request` (a malformed body).

403.description: `forbidden_origin`: the request came from a site that is not the web app.

422.description: `invalid_request`: valid JSON, but not the shape this route takes (or an unknown field).

get.summary: The caller's library, newest first, a page at a time.

403.description: `forbidden`: only creator and admin accounts keep a library.

422.description: `validation_failed`: `source` is not one the API knows.

post.summary: Makes a recording in the caller's library.
post.description:
`201` when this call made it; `200` when it found the one an earlier attempt with the same `id`
made, so a retry after a dropped connection never makes a duplicate.

200.description: Already made by an earlier attempt with this `id`.

400.description: `invalid_request`: the body is not valid JSON for this route.

403.description: `forbidden` (only creator and admin accounts keep a library) or `forbidden_origin`.

404.description: `video_not_found`: `video_id` is not one of your uploads.

409.description: `id_conflict` (the id is taken by something else) or `video_in_use` (that video already belongs to another recording).

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the budget is available again.

get.summary: One recording. Someone else's, a deleted one and a malformed id all answer `404`.

403.description: `forbidden`: only creator and admin accounts keep a library.

delete.summary:
Deletes a recording, and its video unless a course still uses it. Every link to it stops
working at once.

patch.summary: Renames a recording or changes who may watch it.
patch.description:
Optimistic: say which `version` you read, in the body or in `If-Match`. If it has moved on, the
answer is `409 version_conflict` and nothing changes.

parameters.name: If-Match
parameters.description: The version you read, instead of `version` in the body.

409.description: `version_conflict`: it changed since you read it. Reload and try again.

get.summary: The recording's links, newest first, whether they still work or not. Never carries a password.

post.summary:
Makes a share link for a recording. A private recording is switched to `link` in the same
call: a link to something nobody may see would be a trap.

201.description: Made. `link.url` is what to hand out.

400.description: `invalid_request`: the body is not valid JSON for this route.

409.description: `too_many_links`: a recording may have 10 live links; revoke one first.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the budget is available again.

delete.summary: Revokes a link and ends every viewing under way through it. Safe to repeat.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the budget is available again.

expires_at.description: From a minute to ten years from now. Without one the link never expires.

password.description: A speed bump for casual sharing, not an account. Checked before a viewing starts.

id.description:
A client-chosen id (a random UUID). Sending the same one again returns the recording the
first attempt made, so a retry after a dropped connection never makes a duplicate.

source.description: What produces the recording. Fixed for its life.

video_id.description: An upload of the caller's own to attach straight away.

code.description: Stable and machine-readable; branch on this, not on the message.

fields.description: Present on `422 validation_failed`: every invalid field at once.

ErrorResponse.description: Every error the API returns has this shape.

FieldError.description: One invalid field in a request.

field.description: The request field, as the client sent it.

recording_visibility.description:
The recording's visibility after the call: making a link switches a private recording to
`link`, so the client can show it.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page; absent on the last.

status.description: Read from the video underneath; never stored.

version.description: Changes on every edit; send it back to edit.

view_count.description: All-time views, as of the last flush (see `GET /v1/recordings/{id}/views`).

password.description: Not a common password, and not made from the email address.

new_password.description: Not a common password, and not made from the account's email address.

token.description: The one-time token from the emailed link.

SignupRole.description: Who a new account is for. Admins are never self-service.

token.description: The one-time token from the emailed link.

version.description: The version you read. Required, here or in `If-Match`.

visibility.description: Who may watch. Changing it to `private` ends every viewing under way through a link.

session.name: zeno_at
session.description: The access cookie set by sign-in. It lasts minutes; `POST /v1/auth/refresh` renews it.

tags.name: recordings
tags.description: A person's library, and the links that share its recordings.
